entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane whose Bant knights are given as an example of a concept for a white first striker.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara home to noble knights riding leotau.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose village is struck by magical lava from Jund in card art.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: An encroaching shard of Alara from which magical lava comes down on Naya.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: A plane with kithkin tower guardians and spooky spirits.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker whose claw gathers a storm in the art of the card Conflux.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: Un-space between worlds, a metaphysical transition-state of primordial chaos that tears at planeswalkers who pass through it.

relations.note: Jund is encroaching on Naya, sending magical lava onto its villages.
relations.quote: That's magical lava brought down on your little Naya village all the way from the encroaching plane of Jund
